title: Matthjis vH NDE 2199
content: Saturday or Sunday night I woke up because my blood sugar was too low (hypoglycemia). I needed to get some sugar as soon as possible but I was so out of it I could scarcely walk. I instantly knew that this was the worst episode of hypoglycemia I had ever had. I had to act rapidly. After eating something sweet, I went down to the refrigerator to get a drink (my living room and kitchen are on the first floor). My blood sugars were still too low and it was very difficult to walk. When I reached the refrigerator, everything went black before my eyes. The next moment I saw myself lying on my abdomen next to the refrigerator. I saw myself from up above (a bird’s eye view). What was notable to me were the colors. They were very intense and bright. I had a feeling of massive peacefulness with restful silence. I felt no fear at all. The colors in my surroundings were so intense. I simply saw where my refrigerator stands, and I was lying on the ground, but the colors were terribly clear, pure and intense. I felt so pleased and happy. I then felt myself slowly descend toward my body and I suddenly came back. I found myself lying next to the refrigerator on my abdomen. I got up with difficulty and slowly walked back to my bedroom because I was totally exhausted. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 17 april 2005 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Te lage bloedsuikers (hypoglycemia) Other Te lage bloedsuikers (hypoglycemia) Hypoglycemia. I had been diabetic for 3 years. My blood sugar was so low I could scarcely walk. Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster than usual I felt like it lasted only 20-30 seconds, but when I came in and looked at the clock it appeared that I was gone for at least 1 hour. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Very intense, clear and pure colors. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Totally no sound, absolute peaceful silence, a silence which I cannot define in words. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Intense happiness and joy. I totally felt no fear. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Yes I did not believe in God and Christ before at all, and it has become even clearer to me, through this experience, that heaven and hell do not exist, nor do God and Christ. context.nde_cause_other_detail: Hypoglycemia (very low blood sugar) related to diabetes.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Vision went black; then he saw his body from above near the refrigerator with intense colors and peace; then he slowly descended back into his body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported clock-time discrepancy: experience felt like 20–30 seconds, but afterward the clock suggested he was gone at least 1 hour.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The next moment I saw myself lying on my abdomen next to the refrigerator. I saw myself from up above (a bird’s eye view).”
